net.guizhanss.gcereborn.core.adapters

Interface MobAdapter<T extends org.bukkit.entity.LivingEntity>

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    AnimalsAdapter

    public interface MobAdapter<T extends org.bukkit.entity.LivingEntity>
    This class is a wholesale copy of TheBusyBiscuit's MobCapturer.

    This is a simple Adapter that allows conversion between a LivingEntity and a JsonObject.

    Java-8 port note: this no longer implements org.bukkit.persistence.PersistentDataType (a 1.14+-only interface - implementing it would throw NoClassDefFoundError loading this class on 1.8-1.13). toPrimitive(JsonObject)/fromPrimitive(String) are now plain conversion methods; storage goes through PdcCompat's String primitive instead of a real PersistentDataContainer entry (see ChickenUtils/PocketChicken). Attribute snapshotting (1.9+) is isolated in AttributeCompat, gated by CompatUtils.attributesSupported(), for the same reason.
